_comment: THE decisive experiment plus its ablation, both on captures we already have.
target=rescued restricts to rows the model already gets wrong without
thinking, then asks whether thinking rescues them. needs_thinking is
constant on that subset by construction, so an above-chance AUROC here
is signal about the marginal value of reasoning rather than about
difficulty -- which is the only thing separating this work from
prefill_mode=on probes the thinking-ENABLED prompt's prefill state.
Still captured before any token is generated, so no reasoning trace
leaks in and it is not circular; it differs only by the template's
LSAT is excluded: thinking-off accuracy 15.7% is below the 20% floor
for 5-option multiple choice, so its labels are guessing noise.
name: probe_decomposition
